Further sustained rise in US Treasury yields could lead to continued global debt selloff and FII outflows from emerging markets.
The current ranging market regime and lack of clear trend could result in choppy, sideways price action, making directional trades challenging.
Any unexpected domestic or global economic data releases could quickly alter market sentiment.
